question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**improve**" means to enhance or make better. (सुधारना)
 
• In the context of student clubs, the goal is to enhance learning through interaction and discussion.
 
• The other options:** "adjust," "reduce," and "calculate" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Student clubs are the place where students can improve__ their learning through interaction and discussion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjust (समायोजित)**: means to alter or move something slightly to achieve the desired fit or result.
 
• **Reduce (कम करना)**: means to make smaller or less in amount.
 
• **Calculate (गणना करना)**: means to determine the amount or number of something mathematically.
